shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin gained 25%+ in August, marking its best August since 2017, while a weekly death cross formed that some view as a bottoming signal.
Hawkish Jackson Hole remarks from Fed Chair Warsh lowered rate cut expectations and led to a drop in Bitcoin prices.
US strikes against Iranian targets near the Strait of Hormuz heightened geopolitical instability and surged oil prices.
Strategy acquired 4,603 BTC for approximately $369.7 million between August 24-30 at an average price of $80,318.
US spot Ethereum ETFs recorded $225.8 million in daily net inflows, reaching a nine-day streak totaling $1.42 billion.
